# App Assistance

> iOS apps by independent developer Artem Dorozhkin (IE Artem Dorozhkin). Focused, easy-to-use apps for everyday tasks: photo privacy, document scanning, phone storage cleanup, driving exam preparation, health tracking, invoicing and PDF tools. All apps are free to download on the Apple App Store.

## Apps

- [Pixelate: Blur Face & Mosaic](https://appassistance.services/pixelate/): Blur faces automatically and hide license plates, ID numbers and text in photos and screenshots with blur, mosaic or a solid box. Works on-device. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796954642
- [Cleaner: Free Up Phone Storage](https://appassistance.services/cleaner/): Find duplicate and similar photos, screenshots, large videos and duplicate contacts, with a passcode-protected Secret Space. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798713964
- [Georgia Driving Test: DriveGE](https://appassistance.services/drivege/): App for preparing for the official driving licence theory exam in Georgia (the country). Uses the official exam questions of the LEPL Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia. Fully available in English, Russian and Georgian (Russian page: https://appassistance.services/drivege/ru/). Includes unlimited practice, realistic mock exams with official rules and timer, explanations referencing traffic law, road sign catalogue, and progress tracking. Covers licence categories A, B, C, D and AM. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774959850
- [Pulse Measure & Blood Pressure](https://appassistance.services/pulse/): Measure heart rate with the iPhone camera, log blood pressure, guided breathing when readings are high, Apple Health and Apple Watch sync. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748323105
- [Calora: Food & Calorie Tracker](https://appassistance.services/calora/): Calorie, macro and meal tracker with food journal, calorie calculator, keto and low-carb support. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751401048
- [ScanPro: PDF Scanner & Editor](https://appassistance.services/scanpro/): Scan ID cards and documents to PDF, fill in PDF forms and sign them, OCR, merge and compress PDF. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748518542
- [Invoice: Estimates & Receipts](https://appassistance.services/invoice/): Create invoices, estimates and receipts, track payments and clients, analytics and PDF export. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6753165868
- [PDF: Reader, Scanner, Editor](https://appassistance.services/pdf/): All-in-one PDF toolkit — reader, editor, e-signature, scanner with OCR, converter, form filling. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742465810
- [Book: EPUB, PDF & FB2 Reader](https://appassistance.services/book/): Ebook reader for EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, PDF, TXT, DOCX, RTF and CBZ comics, with text to speech, translation, highlights and notes, and a reading tracker with daily goals, streaks, widgets and Siri. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811408221
